FAQ

Questions before
we begin?

A few practical answers about scope, revisions, maintenance and working together.

Which platforms do you work with?

I specialize in Webflow and Webflow CMS. I also build in WordPress with Oxygen and Elementor when the project calls for it.

Do I need branding before we start?

Yes. You provide the brand direction, logo, copy and assets. I do not offer branding, but I can introduce you to professionals who do.

How do homepage drafts and revisions work?

I prepare two or three homepage drafts and we choose one main direction. The homepage includes up to two revision rounds. Static pages have up to two rounds for the whole set; CMS pages have up to two rounds for the CMS stage.

What does a CMS collection mean in your packages?

A collection is a content type and its template, such as articles, projects or team members. Individual entries are not static pages. Content entry and migration volume are confirmed in your quote.

Are AI images included?

Each website package includes up to 10 AI-generated images, with up to three image revisions in total for the package. Each revision applies to one image. I do not offer photo editing, although some adjustments may be possible with AI.

Do you write the content?

Partially, yes. You need to provide the complete information about your business, services and project in a document. I then restructure and adapt that material into clear, organized website content.

Can you migrate an existing website?

Yes. We review the current platform, content, URLs, CMS and integrations before defining the migration scope. Redirects and launch checks are part of the planning.

Do you offer maintenance?

Yes. Three months of maintenance cost the same as the agreed website price. Monthly AI image allowances are 1, 3, 5 or 7 for the USD 200, 600, 1,000 or 1,500 starting packages respectively. The scope is confirmed before we start.

What does localization plugin support cost?

Installation costs USD 100 once. Plugin maintenance costs USD 50 per month. The client pays the plugin subscription or license separately. The plugin and platform are confirmed before setup.

Which payment methods do you accept?

PayPal, AirTM-to-AirTM transfers, my AirTM virtual US account, Binance International and USDT to my wallet. I do not use Binance.US. Payment details and the USDT network are confirmed directly.

Will I own the website?

Hosting and domains stay in your name. At delivery, the Webflow project is transferred to your account.

How long will my project take?

The timeline depends on scope, content readiness, migration volume and feedback. We agree on a schedule after reviewing the project.
